name: io.github.your-org/nexoomni-mcp
description: Drive a NexoOmni WhatsApp CRM from Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients. Internal use only — not published to the public MCP registry.

environmentVariables.name: NEXOOMNI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your NexoOmni instance, e.g. https://crm.example.com

environmentVariables.name: NEXOOMNI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: NexoOmni API key (Settings → API keys). Its scopes decide what is allowed.

environmentVariables.name: NEXOOMNI_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose contact create/update, message sending, conversation assignment, and internal notes. Read-only when unset.

environmentVariables.name: NEXOOMNI_ENABLE_BROADCASTS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose the mass-broadcast tool. Requires NEXOOMNI_ENABLE_WRITES.
